config.label: Sets the minimum log level for output (e
config.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

config.label: Register the gated toolkit_check_network tool
config.description: Register the gated toolkit_check_network tool. Off by default — leave off for hosted/shared deployments.

config.label: Register the gated toolkit_check_system tool
config.description: Register the gated toolkit_check_system tool. Off by default — only meaningful on a local deployment.

config.label: With network diagnostics enabled, permit private/reserved/loopback targets
config.description: With network diagnostics enabled, permit private/reserved/loopback targets. The second explicit gate; off by default.

config.label: IP-geolocation provider id
config.description: IP-geolocation provider id. Default 'ip-api' is the keyless free tier.

config.label: API key for the geolocation provider, if it requires one
config.description: API key for the geolocation provider, if it requires one. The default ip-api tier is keyless.

config.label: Base URL for the geolocation provider
config.description: Base URL for the geolocation provider. Default is the keyless ip-api endpoint.

config.label: Geolocation cache TTL in seconds
config.description: Geolocation cache TTL in seconds. Geolocation is stable, so repeats are cached.

config.label: Max geolocation requests per minute; excess requests are rejected with a retryable rate-limit error
config.description: Max geolocation requests per minute; excess requests are rejected with a retryable rate-limit error. Default 45 matches the ip-api free tier.
